TAKE & BAKE.name: Take & Bake Tater Tot Casserole (6 servings)
TAKE & BAKE.desc: This feel-good twist on Tater Tot Casserole is full of ground turkey, delicious homemade sauce, and plentiful veggies. Get ready for a hearty, comforting dinner! Pop the container into your oven and have a 6-serving meal ready in under 30 minutes!

SALADS.name: Broccoli Farro Salad (with added Chicken)
SALADS.desc: We've taken a potluck classic and given it a HUGE upgrade!! It's packed with sweet and savory flavors and crunchy and chewy textures. It's full of nutrients, and is so delicious you won't want to stop eating it! Also available as a plant-based salad.
